label: A2 entire causal chain, ungroundedness…: An entire chain has no cause of one of its members…
term: A2 entire causal chain, ungroundedness and internal head
definition: An entire chain has no cause of one of its members outside that chain; ungrounded excludes even partial outside causes of members. Infinite is glossed as lacking a first member, not infinite cardinality. A head is a cause or partial cause not caused by any element of the chain. A2c asserts that every concrete thing already in a causal chain belongs to an entire chain. It does not define linear comparability or a single predecessor, nor assert that the entire chain is a separate caused individual.
note: A2P1 infinite/ungrounded term@title; A2c steps1–4 and head term@title at6–7. A branching finite-ancestor interpretation is compatible but not stipulated as a formal identity. A source in that graph may be isolated and fail the stronger cause/partial-cause role of a head. Closure of member causes is not a member-to-whole causal-production law. Declaration-completion investigation (2026-11-09): TruthCore.Causality.EntireChainHead.Chain provides independent arbitrary-carrier bodies Entire, Ungrounded and Head. Full and partial productive relations are explicit framework primitives with no structural laws assumed; Head requires an outgoing full or partial contribution to a member and excludes incoming full or partial causes from members. Entire alone does not exclude outside partial contributors; Ungrounded plus Head excludes incoming causes from the selected ambient carrier. These are partial components, NOT a binding of either original composite sense. Owner approved both sibling interpretations. See CausalNoFirst and OrderedNoFirst: causal incoming-minimum versus separate strict-order minimality, with alignment explicit. Neither sibling is an unqualified mapping of this original composite record. Both original sense allowances remain. No no-first/cardinality/well-foundedness equivalence, whole causation, capability/domain denial, or actual-bearer bridge is inferred. Applicability of the productive primitives and population selection remains open; isolated sources and branching/multiple productive heads distinguish rival interpretations. Infinite-history control imposes no restriction on the general carrier.
